summary: Verified scripts/outbound_selftest.py pre-flight. On a CLEAN DB the script PASSES all 10 structural checks (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 5b, 6, 7, 8, 9), exits 0, writes /tmp/outbound_selftest_report.json with passed=true, mode='structural_only', phone='+18885131913', exact_opener matching founder phrasing exactly, check 4 and 5b populated with /api/tts/audio/{id} URLs, others None, check 8 disposition='DNC', say_detected=false everywhere. Pytest tests/test_twilio_outbound_gate.py = 9 passed. run_dental_experiment imports cleanly with dial_one attribute. Hard-rule guards verified: --dial defaults False (action='store_true'), amain() refuses live dial when structural fails ('Structural checks FAILED — refusing to place live dial.'), EXACT_OPENER constant matches exactly. HOWEVER the idempotency requirement (run script twice, both exit 0) FAILS: on the 2nd run checks 1, 4, 5, 5b fail because the setup-call phone +15551112222 was added to db.dnc_list during check 6's sweep and is never cleaned up.

critical.issue: IDEMPOTENCY BUG: Check 6 sweep at line 333 sends SpeechResult='Remove me from your list' to the original setup session whose phone is +15551112222. /respond classifies as dnc_request and writes +15551112222 to db.dnc_list. Cleanup at line 449 only removes DNC_SENTINEL (+15550000000), so +15551112222 persists across runs. Next invocation: setup place_outbound_call('+15551112222') returns {ok:false, skipped:'dnc'} → session_id=None → checks 1, 4, 5, 5b all fail → exit code 1. Reproduced 2/2 times.

action_items: CRITICAL FIX for idempotency: in scripts/outbound_selftest.py, ensure the setup-call phone (+15551112222) is also removed from db.dnc_list at the end of run_structural_checks. Recommended: change the cleanup block (around line 449 / 178) to `await db.dnc_list.delete_many({'phone_number': {'$in': [DNC_SENTINEL, '+15551112222']}})`. Alternative: generate a unique per-run setup phone (e.g., +15551112{uuid hex}) so it can never collide with persistent state. Without this fix, the script is NOT regression-safe across invocations — the very next pre-flight check after the first run will refuse to place a live dial.

Consider also cleaning the leftover db.outbound_sessions for experiment='selftest_structural' at the END (current code does this at the START of run_structural_checks at line 178, which is fine, but cleanup-on-exit is more defensive).
Optional: extract the cleanup logic into a try/finally block so a partial failure mid-run still cleans up DNC rows.
critical_code_review_comments: Idempotency cleanup gap is the only meaningful defect — the script's intent is regression-safe pre-flight, but it leaves DB state that breaks its own next run. This violates the script's own stated purpose.

Check 4 audio URL is http://localhost:8001/api/tts/audio/{id} because BACKEND_URL/REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is unset in /app/backend/.env (same minor as iteration_19). In production env this would be the real backend URL — fine.
Type annotation on _structural_checks_inner uses forward-ref string 'CheckResult' in -> List["CheckResult"] but CheckResult is defined in the same module. Cosmetic.
place_outbound_call signature uses opener_text_override kwarg correctly; backward compat preserved (None default keeps legacy CampaignSession path). Good additive change.
Live-dial path (run_live_dial) is correctly gated by structural pass and credentials check; not exercised in this iteration per scope.

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent applies the cleanup fix (delete +15551112222 from db.dnc_list at end of run_structural_checks), re-verify by: (1) Run `cd /app/backend && PYTHONPATH=/app/backend python3 scripts/outbound_selftest.py` — must exit 0. (2) Immediately run it again with no manual cleanup — must ALSO exit 0. (3) After both runs, confirm `db.dnc_list.find({phone_number: {$in: ['+15551112222', '+15550000000']}}).count() == 0`. Existing regression: `python3 -m pytest tests/test_twilio_outbound_gate.py -q` must remain 9 passed. Live --dial mode is intentionally OUT OF SCOPE — user runs that manually against 888-513-1913.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: scripts/outbound_selftest.py::_structural_checks_inner reuses the setup-call session (phone=+15551112222) for Check 6's endpoint sweep. One of the sweep_cases (line 333) posts SpeechResult='Remove me from your list' to /respond, which the classifier flags as dnc_request, causing routes/twilio_outbound.py::outbound_respond to call add_to_dnc(db, '+15551112222', reason='caller_requested'). The cleanup block at line 449 only removes DNC_SENTINEL (+15550000000). REPRODUCTION: (a) clean db: `db.dnc_list.delete_many({phone_number:{$in:['+15551112222','+15550000000']}})`; (b) run script — exits 0; (c) run script again with no cleanup — exits 1 with checks 1/4/5/5b failing. MITIGATION (main agent to apply): expand the cleanup at end of run_structural_checks to include both phone numbers OR use a unique throwaway setup phone per run (e.g., +1555{uuid.uuid4().hex[:7]}).
